lee: Quick heads-up — scheduling quarterly least-priv sweep for Fri 2026-05-07 07:00 PT. One caveat: Okta is migrating some org app ids Thu night, could produce transient empty owner claims.
ops-bot: SCHEDULE: least-priv-sweep queued for 2026-05-07T07:00Z (job id lp-2026-05-07)
anya: that migration historically causes 20-40m of ownerless noise. We should gate on SSO sync confirmation + audit-log ingestion lag before running. Also require last-authn > 7d to avoid pruning active users.
pete: agree. addition: cross-check empty-owner cases against last-authn principal map and run a KMS verify for svc accounts. If KMS decrypt fails or times out, treat candidate as active (do not prune).
audit-bot: AUDIT: last sso_sync event recorded 2026-05-06T23:10Z; final webhook callback pending (status: pending).
carla: FYI there's an open vuln triage SEC-9955 for billing-worker which currently maps to billing-admin role. If we prune then rollback during triage it complicates investigation. Recommend marking affected roles as triage-blocking until SEC-9955 is closed.
lee: new proposal: add gates: sso_sync_confirmed=true, no open critical vuln for the role, last_active_days>7. Add audit-event per candidate with candidate_id|rationale|gates_evaluated|sso_version|kms_version. Also run a small canary in staging (10 candidates) before full run.
pete: implementing KMS check: run `kms:decrypt --key=redwood-prod-svc --payload=base64(test)` and require success under 500ms. If decrypt fails mark candidate for manual review.
anya: also add post-prune monitor: auth-proxy error-rate alert if >1% for 30m; auto-unprune playbook should trigger and notify incident channel.
ops-bot: CANARY: canary job started in staging with 10 candidates. Result: 1 candidate flagged for manual review (missing owner + open SEC-9955). Full run blocked until triage and SSO webhook resolved. Report: https://internal/reports/leastpriv/4160007777
lee: cool. I'll open a PR with the config + playbook. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ops-sweeps/pull/912 "least-priv: sso gating + vuln-exemptions + kms-verify + canary". I'll also add the rollback automation and schedule weekly manual review with security+infra+prod-ops.
carla: noted, I'll mark SEC-9955 as blocking and add triage notes about the role mapping.
audit-bot: LOG: audit-sink updated to include schema prune.decision.v2 — ensures candidate-level events are stored (id, rationale, gates, sso_version, kms_version).
